q1_issues.issue: In "The nightmoth crowd at the Harbor Row shrank" the PP sits inside the subject NP and so states where the crowd is, but the parse emits an event Location on the shrinking instead of an entity-attached position atom, and the instruction set makes that entity/event head split load-bearing.

notes: Statement 24 attaches the same PP to the hunt event, which is a defensible post-verbal VP reading there even if the passage treats "the nightmoth crowd at the Harbor Row" as a fixed definite description. The fictional day-of-year dating ("day 258 of Year 1") maps cleanly onto the stated (Day n)/(Year n) terms, and the compound genus, group/cardinality, distribution-rule and Before/after-the-hunt handling all follow doctrine.
